name: session-pane
description: A pane beside the chat that shows what the session does now: denied permissions, changed files with their diffs, running agents and background tasks, and the open tasks of your TODO file.

taskFiles.title: Task files
taskFiles.description: Comma-separated paths from the project folder. The first file found fills the Tasks part.

taskFormat.title: Task format
taskFormat.description: checkbox: each open '- [ ] text' line. heading: each '## Task <id>: <title>' line. custom: the Task pattern below.

taskPattern.title: Task pattern
taskPattern.description: With Task format custom: a regex one task line matches, with a named group 'title' and an optional named group 'id'.

showPermissions.title: Show denied permissions
showPermissions.description: Calls auto mode denied, until a later call of the same tool and input is allowed.

showChanged.title: Show changed files
showChanged.description: Files git lists as changed or untracked; a press on a name shows its diff.

showAgents.title: Show agents
showAgents.description: Running agents and background tasks (shell, monitor, workflow).

showTasks.title: Show tasks
showTasks.description: Open tasks of the first task file found.
